name: abstention_cannot_mute_escalation
description: tars T 1.0 + ix F 1.0 on the same claim_key synthesize C at full weight, then three Unknown bystanders flood the claim. Raw masses T=F=C=1, U=3, so dist[C]=1/6≈0.1667. Under v1.1 (dist[C] > 0.3 over the full mass) this was BELOW threshold — abstention muted a genuine T/F contradiction. Under v1.2 escalation is a share of the informative mass (T+P+D+F+C, Unknown excluded): informative = 1 - dist[U] = 0.5, so C/informative = 0.1667/0.5 = 0.3333 > 0.3 and escalation triggers. This fixture flips from false (v1.1) to true (v1.2) by design — the abstention-muting hole from GuitarAlchemist/hari#28. The synthesized diagnosis_id is the byte-equal pin, identical to fixture 02's since the T/F pair is the same.
